title: Binary Constant-Output Machine
statement: For each finite Boolean word $w$, there is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with no work tapes and $|w|+1$ states, whose initial state is $0$ and whose transition in state $i$ is the action obtained from the constant-output construction for $w$, the identity state map, and $i$.
caveat: The definition of the constant-output action construction is not included, so the machine's transition behavior cannot be described more explicitly.
